limits: Fixed candidate1/control2/candidate2 order does not remove temporal provider drift.
Original control1 uses an immutable-row combination with one protocol error; availability gains cannot be credited to the prompt.
Gold quote coverage and strict aliases are conservative proxies; all changed outcomes require citation/scope review.
Repeats remain inside 12 source families; this is not 24 independent cases or a statistically established semantic improvement.
Original failed control usage is unknown; whole token/cost deltas are not known.
